_note: Pre-registered before any G1 result was seen (2026-11-03). Do not edit after results exist; add a new versioned file instead.
selection: Pick the single trial with the highest median net Sharpe across in-sample splits. Report every trial; trial count = 10.

gate_g1.oos_sharpe_ci: stationary block bootstrap of daily returns, mean block 10 days, 2000 reps, at fees x2
gate_g1.positive_splits: net return > 0 in a majority of all 6 splits, and 2022 must be among them
gate_g1.shadow_rule: If ETH (zero-capital control) passes, flag the fill model as possibly too generous and rerun with fill_haircut 0.7 before trusting any pass.
